Introduce yourself for interim assignments

We hear from interim managers, programme and project leads, business analysts, and service improvement specialists who work in public services.

What to send

Send your CV and a short account of an assignment you’d take on again. What were you responsible for? What had changed by the time you handed it back?

Include your availability, where you can work, your preferred working arrangements, and an indicative rate.

Email the recruitment team

We discuss your availability and interest when there’s a relevant assignment. An introduction carries no guarantee of work.
